strata.metadata: Five error contexts, each scalar/pointer; private display labels change but semantics do not.
strata.contracts: Five calling contexts, each scalar/pointer; four imported argument types encode a private four-bit contract.

primary_endpoint: Initial fixed-query diagnostic distinctions between private-world pairs sharing the same public interface and verdict.
adaptive_endpoint: Public-model bit probes identify a four-bit contract using verdicts; all queries and visible replies are logged.
repair_endpoint: Fixed finite candidate enumeration uses identical public interface knowledge and only explicit returned constraints to prune.
timing: Wall-clock subprocess timings are recorded descriptively, not interpreted as timing confidentiality or causal performance evidence.
decision_rules: Report oracle-only disclosure separately from extra diagnostic distinctions.
Treat any private-label exposure in projected views or metadata-world distinction as failed conformance.
Report equivalent redaction/projection behavior rather than assuming projection superiority.
Do not generalize finite fixture equivalence to arbitrary inputs or hostile process execution.
No inference about LLM repair usefulness or deployment incidence.
